title: Wall Pass
description: A simple one-touch pass against a wall to improve passing accuracy and first touch.
instructions: Stand 2-3 meters from a wall. Pass the ball against the wall using the inside of your foot, control the rebound, and repeat. Alternate feet.

title: Cone Dribbling
description: Dribble through a line of cones using both feet to improve close control.
instructions: Place cones in a straight line 1 meter apart. Dribble through the cones using quick touches, alternating feet. Return to start and repeat.

title: Shuttle Runs
description: Sprint between two points to improve acceleration and anaerobic fitness.
instructions: Place two cones 20 meters apart. Sprint from one cone to the other, touch the ground, and sprint back. Repeat for desired repetitions.

title: Heading Practice
description: Throw the ball against a wall and head it back to improve heading accuracy and timing.
instructions: Stand 2 meters from a wall. Throw the ball against the wall and attempt to head it back at a specific point on the wall. Repeat.

title: Keepie Uppie (Juggling)
description: Solo ball juggling using feet, thighs and other body parts to keep the ball off the ground, building touch and coordination.
instructions: Drop the ball and use your feet, thighs, chest, shoulders or head to keep it off the ground, alternating body parts. Count consecutive touches without letting the ball hit the ground and try to beat your own record.

title: Jumping Jacks
description: A full-body bodyweight movement combining a jump with arm and leg extension, used as a warm-up or conditioning drill.
instructions: Start standing with feet together and arms at your sides. Jump while spreading your legs shoulder-width apart and raising your arms overhead. Jump again to return to the starting position with feet together and arms lowered. Repeat rhythmically for the desired number of repetitions or time.

title: Rondo (Possession Circle)
description: A possession passing game where a group of players keeps the ball away from one or more defenders in the middle, developing quick passing and decision-making under pressure.
instructions: Mark out a small open area. Possessing players position themselves around the edge while one or two defenders stand in the middle trying to intercept or touch the ball. Possessing players move the ball quickly with one or two touches; if a defender wins the ball, swap them with the player who lost it.

title: Box Breathing
description: A structured breathing technique using equal counts for inhale, hold, exhale and hold, used to reduce pre-match anxiety and regain focus.
instructions: Sit or stand comfortably and exhale fully. Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4. Hold your breath for a count of 4. Exhale slowly for a count of 4. Hold your breath again for a count of 4. Repeat the cycle for 3-4 rounds.
